test_cases.question: What is the refund window for an unopened item?
test_cases.ground_truth: Unopened items can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
test_cases.context: Returns: Unopened items can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery. Opened items are eligible for store credit only, within 14 days.

test_cases.question: Can I get a cash refund on an item I already opened?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Opened items are eligible for store credit only, and only within 14 days.
test_cases.context: Returns: Unopened items can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery. Opened items are eligible for store credit only, within 14 days.

test_cases.question: How long does a refund take to appear on my card?
test_cases.ground_truth: Refunds are issued within 3 business days of the return arriving at the warehouse, and banks typically post them 5 to 10 business days after that.
test_cases.context: Refund processing: Refunds are issued within 3 business days of the return arriving at our warehouse. Your bank typically posts the credit 5-10 business days later.

test_cases.question: Do you charge for return shipping?
test_cases.ground_truth: Return shipping is free for defective or incorrect items; otherwise a flat 5.99 USD is deducted from the refund.
test_cases.context: Return shipping: Free for defective or incorrect items. For all other returns a flat fee of $5.99 is deducted from the refund.

test_cases.question: What happens if my package never arrives?
test_cases.ground_truth: File a missing-package claim within 21 days of the shipping date and support will either reship the order or refund it in full.
test_cases.context: Lost packages: File a missing-package claim within 21 days of the ship date. We will reship the order or refund it in full, at your choice.

test_cases.question: Can I change the delivery address after ordering?
test_cases.ground_truth: Only while the order is still in Processing status; once it ships the address cannot be changed.
test_cases.context: Address changes: Possible only while the order shows Processing. Once an order ships the address is locked and cannot be changed.

test_cases.question: Is next-day delivery available to rural postcodes?
test_cases.ground_truth: Next-day delivery covers metro postcodes only; rural addresses receive standard delivery in 3 to 5 business days.
test_cases.context: Delivery speeds: Next-day delivery is available to metro postcodes only. Rural addresses receive standard delivery in 3-5 business days.

test_cases.question: Do you ship internationally?
test_cases.ground_truth: International shipping is available to 23 countries, with duties and taxes paid by the recipient at delivery.
test_cases.context: International: We ship to 23 countries. Duties and taxes are the recipient's responsibility and are collected at delivery.

test_cases.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
test_cases.ground_truth: Cancel from Account, then Subscriptions, then Cancel plan; access continues until the end of the paid period.
test_cases.context: Subscriptions: Cancel any time under Account > Subscriptions > Cancel plan. Access continues until the end of the current paid period. No partial-month refunds are issued.

test_cases.question: If I cancel mid-month, do I get a partial refund?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Partial-month refunds are not issued; access simply continues to the end of the paid period.
test_cases.context: Subscriptions: Cancel any time under Account > Subscriptions > Cancel plan. Access continues until the end of the current paid period. No partial-month refunds are issued.

test_cases.question: Why was I charged twice this month?
test_cases.ground_truth: A second charge in the same month usually means the plan was upgraded mid-cycle, which bills the prorated difference immediately.
test_cases.context: Billing: Upgrading a plan mid-cycle bills the prorated difference immediately, which appears as a second charge in the same month.

test_cases.question: What payment methods do you accept?
test_cases.ground_truth: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. Bank transfer is available for business accounts only.
test_cases.context: Payments: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. Bank transfer is available on business accounts only.

test_cases.question: Can I use two discount codes on one order?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Only one discount code can be applied per order.
test_cases.context: Promotions: Only one discount code may be applied per order. Codes cannot be combined or applied retroactively.

test_cases.question: I forgot to apply my code — can it be added after checkout?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Discount codes cannot be applied retroactively to a completed order.
test_cases.context: Promotions: Only one discount code may be applied per order. Codes cannot be combined or applied retroactively.

test_cases.question: How long is the warranty on electronics?
test_cases.ground_truth: Electronics carry a 24-month manufacturer warranty covering defects, but not accidental or liquid damage.
test_cases.context: Warranty: Electronics carry a 24-month manufacturer warranty against defects. Accidental damage and liquid damage are not covered.

test_cases.question: My laptop got wet — is that covered by warranty?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Liquid damage is explicitly excluded from the manufacturer warranty.
test_cases.context: Warranty: Electronics carry a 24-month manufacturer warranty against defects. Accidental damage and liquid damage are not covered.

test_cases.question: How do I start a warranty claim?
test_cases.ground_truth: Submit the order number and photos of the fault through the Warranty Claim form; assessment takes up to 5 business days.
test_cases.context: Warranty claims: Submit your order number and photos of the fault via the Warranty Claim form. Assessment takes up to 5 business days.

test_cases.question: Can someone else return an item on my behalf?
test_cases.ground_truth: Yes, if they have the order number and the original confirmation email; the refund still goes to the original payment method.
test_cases.context: Returns authorisation: A third party may return an item with the order number and original confirmation email. Refunds always go to the original payment method.

test_cases.question: Do you price match competitors?
test_cases.ground_truth: Price matching applies to identical in-stock items from listed authorised retailers, claimed within 7 days of purchase.
test_cases.context: Price match: We match identical, in-stock items from listed authorised retailers. Claims must be made within 7 days of purchase.

test_cases.question: What is the refund policy for gift cards?
test_cases.ground_truth: Gift cards are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash.
test_cases.context: Gift cards: Non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash. Unused balances do not expire.

test_cases.question: Do gift card balances expire?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Unused gift card balances do not expire.
test_cases.context: Gift cards: Non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash. Unused balances do not expire.

test_cases.question: Can I return an item bought 60 days ago because it was a gift?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. The policy does not extend the 30-day window for gifts, so a 60-day-old purchase is outside the return window.
test_cases.context: Returns: Unopened items can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery. No exceptions are made for gift purchases.

test_cases.question: What is your policy on returning perishable food items?
test_cases.ground_truth: Perishable food items cannot be returned for hygiene reasons.
test_cases.context: Returns exclusions: Perishable food, opened cosmetics and personalised items cannot be returned for hygiene and customisation reasons.

test_cases.question: Will you refund an item I bought from a third-party marketplace seller?
test_cases.ground_truth: No. Marketplace seller orders are covered by the seller's own policy, not the store policy.
test_cases.context: Marketplace: Orders fulfilled by third-party sellers are governed by that seller's return policy, not ours. Contact the seller directly.
